problem.body: A weak website – or no website at all – sends customers to your competitors. The choice isn't easy: a cheap freelancer who disappears, or an agency that charges like a corporation. Nexova is the third option.

about.h2: Nexova is one person – and you talk directly to them.
about.body: No middlemen, no call centres. I run your project personally, from the first conversation through launch and ongoing support. That's how I stay fast and you always know who you're dealing with.

guarantee.h2: We find the bug – we fix it for free.
guarantee.body: For 30 days after launch I fix reported issues at no extra cost. Because a website should work, not just look good.

q1.q: How much does a website cost?
q1.a: It depends on scope. Packages start from 1,500 PLN, and you'll get an exact price in a free quote – no obligations.

q2.a: Usually a few weeks, depending on project size.

q3.q: Can I update the content later?
q3.a: Small changes are included in the Care plan. If you want to edit yourself, we add a simple CMS.

q4.a: During the guarantee period I fix issues for free. After that, you have the Care plan.

q5.q: Do you work with Czech businesses?
q5.a: Yes – I serve clients in Poland and Czechia, also in Czech.

finalCta.h2: Ready for a website that brings in clients?
